title: Highly Recommended
text: Our tour guide Vitaly was very knowledgeable and informative. We thoroughly enjoyed the entire experience. This was so much better than just doing the tour on our own, or buying the audio option within the museum. Highly recommended!

title: Great Tour/Great Guide
text:
The guide, Vitaliy was great. Engaging, knowledgeable and fueled all of our questions. He was a pleasure to spend a few hours with and learn not only about Picasso but his adopted city as well.

Well done.
author: F5842OTgarys

title: Excellent, interesting and fun!
text: Vitaly was a great tour guide, very informative but fun - book your tour with him and you won’t be disappointed!
author: 697NickT

title: Livtour and Vitaly….. the BEST!
text: Vitaly was AMAZING!  We learned so much about Picasso and his life.  Vitalty was very knowledgeable, personable and professional. He took us through the “Picasso” area of Barcelona where he lived and created his art.  Vitaly presented examples of his early works and explained in detail the correlation between his environment and his art.  Too many amazing examples to list.  I highly recommend Livtour and Vitaly as your guide if you want an exceptional tour.
author: 411jenniferL

title: Wonderful overview of Picasso- the man and the artist
text: Vitaly was a pleasure to be with. He was extremely well versed in the history of the area and of Picasso’s life. He made the art and the artist come to life.
author: lindaw964

title: Picasso Brought to Life by Vitaily
text:
We had a fantastic experience on LIV Tours’ Picasso Museum tour in Barcelona with Vitaliy. I would highly recommend this tour to anyone interested not only in Picasso’s artwork, but also in understanding the person behind the paintings.

Vitaliy did an excellent job bringing Picasso’s life to life by weaving together his family, friendships, relationships, the cities where he lived, and the historical and cultural context that shaped his work. title: Picasso Museum with Vitaliy
